svg.text: Flatten 40 of each end in a vice between two flat bars, both flats

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the same plane; anneal with a gas torch first if it cracks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Trim each flat to 26 wide and round its end to a 13 radius about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End holes 6.6, 595.3 apart; a second 6.6 hole 20 in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from each end hole, on the centre line. Two holes at each end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: make the joints rigid, so the bracket cannot fold.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The strut rises at 55 degrees from the wall foot to the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the second pair with the strut clamped to both cleats, so all

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: M6 bolts, heads on the strut side, nyloc nuts on the cleats.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: end holes within 0.5 of the length; flats not twisted.
